label: Experientialism fails, from the stay-out verdict on two same-profile lives (inference)
rule: The transfer bridge gives a respect of difference; experientialism at the shared profile excludes it
meaning: If the real life and the machine life share an experiential profile, the real life is better for its subject, and betterness requires a respect in which the better life is desirable and the other is not, then some respect separates two same-profile lives, so experientialism fails for that desirability relation. Its argument refutes the recorded rival experientialism. All three premises are OPEN; the refutation counts for nothing in the frontier until they are established, and even then it would defeat only this rival, not the partial-experientialist and restricted models that also give the verdict (controls rows 4 and 5).
